$schema: This bundle's own Claude Code settings -- SEED content, copied once and then yours. `outputStyle` selects the Brief style the seed ships at .claude/output-styles/brief.md (the `Needs you:` contract every loopd report follows); a bundle stamped before 2026-10-28 adds the key by hand -- `/loopd:welcome check` names it. `subagentPromptCacheTtl` is for NEW bundles ONLY: this file is copied once and refresh-seeds.sh never merges it, so no existing bundle receives that key -- the shipped mechanism is `experimental.cacheTtl` on the project-manager agent, which travels with the plugin. The 1h TTL is ignored while a Claude subscription is drawing on usage credits, where it falls back to the default 5m. The four loopd hooks (SessionStart banner, UserPromptSubmit push-state, and the two PreToolUse enforcement hooks) are NOT registered here any more: they ship with the loopd plugin and fire per machine, so one install arms every bundle instead of only the ones somebody re-stamped. `permissions.deny` stays here because a plugin manifest has no permissions block to carry it, and it is the unconditional second layer behind the deny-destructive hook.
